prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Wide atmospheric brand background for a statement section below the hero on the Promo Group website. It will have large live HTML text over its left and center, so keep those regions empty.
Primary request: A single large smooth sculptural ribbon of translucent orange glass on a warm graphite background. The ribbon stands and folds elegantly only within the rightmost third of the frame. An abstract refined physical brand sculpture.
Scene/backdrop: Seamless warm dark graphite studio, close to #252321. Left two thirds of the image must remain completely calm, dark, empty and flat enough to support white HTML text. Softly lit studio floor may be visible only under the sculpture on the far right.
Composition/framing: Extremely wide landscape banner, 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 1800x600. Camera straight on, slight three-quarter perspective on the ribbon. Orange object concentrated entirely in the right third, around x=72% to 97%. No orange streaks or objects extending into center or left. Sculpture is vertically prominent, a gracefully looping substantial glass ribbon with a continuous S-like fold; one unified object, dimensional and subtly asymmetric.
Style/medium: High-end photorealistic 3D product still life, sophisticated architectural glass, fine rounded edges and realistic refractions. Premium quiet editorial art direction, no busy detail.
Lighting/mood: Soft directional studio illumination on the right, matte dark environment, natural restrained glass highlights. No luminous glow or neon.
Color palette: Warm graphite #252321 background, hot orange #ff8331 glass with subtle red-orange #eb4a3f inner refractions, tiny soft pale reflections.
Text: No text of any kind, no lettering.
Constraints: No logo, no symbols, no icons, no watermark, no typography, no words. No computer, robot, face, brain, microchip. No purple, blue, neon, sparks, particles. Preserve large uninterrupted negative space across the left and center, approximately two-thirds of the full banner.
